name: Chijoku Tsuma Mayumi ~Musuko no Katei Kyoushi~
original_name: 恥辱妻・真由美 ～息子の家庭教師～
source:
Mayumi was not satisfied with the tutor of her a foolishly loving son, Masanori.
She tried to discuss the problem with her husband but he was no help. For several years, they had no sex life to speak of.
As she had not experienced the man’s touch for sometime, Mayumi began to lose her inner sexual desire.
One day, out of nowhere, she was held tightly from the behind by her son’s tutor, Shinichi.
From this moment on, Mayumi’s daily life changed suddenly.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE042494.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
日下真由美對自己百般溺愛的兒子正則的家教一直心存不滿。
她試圖與丈夫商量這個問題，對方卻絲毫派不上用場。而且夫妻二人已經數年沒有任何像樣的性生活。
長期未曾感受男性的愛撫，真由美內心的性慾也開始逐漸枯萎。
某天，兒子的家教真一突然從背後緊緊抱住了她。
從這一刻起，真由美的日常生活驟然改變。
